name: Ironhide Bulwark
description: a squat imp bolted into a full suit of riveted iron plate, shield-like pauldrons, only red eyes showing

poses.stand: standing ready, facing right, glowing with heat
poses.dead: collapsed and breaking apart in a burst of embers

idle.action: breathes and shifts in place, glow pulsing slowly

attack.action: performs its signature attack toward the right, glow flaring

hurt.action: is struck, jerks back, then settles

die.action: flares bright, breaks apart in a burst of embers and goes still
